answer: Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 34 per proof, 30294 for 891, owed every epoch with no exception. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch. One zephyr proves a maker, one bridge proves a payment, one river proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. One threshold for every key: Rim solderer silver mark mounted on the polishing lathe, and one receipt, each silver is a sworn joint count witnessed by two masters, no matter whose hand carries it.
